title: Shadow puppets for a community show
passage:
M: I brought the moon cutout, but there’s a crease down the middle of the paper screen.
F: Use the spare screen in the blue sleeve. The one in the grey sleeve is for the little window on the ticket stand.
M: Should I move the lamp back? The moon looks too small from here.
F: Keep the lamp where it is and bring the cutout a little closer to it. That will make the shadow bigger. We can test it before the children come in, but leave the front row free until the staff finish sweeping.
passageZh:
M: 我把月亮剪影帶來了，但紙幕中間有一道摺痕。
F: 用藍色套子裡的備用紙幕。灰色套子裡那張是給售票台小窗口用的。
M: 我該把燈往後移嗎？從這裡看，月亮太小了。
F: 燈先別動，把剪影往燈靠近一點，影子就會變大。小朋友進場前可以先試，但工作人員掃完地之前，第一排要先空著。
